2609.08788.title: Adaptive Anisotropic Attention for Axis-Structured Signals
2609.08788.paper_summary: Dense self-attention treats all token pairs as equally plausible before learning, an interaction-isotropic prior that can be mismatched to structured signals. For structured, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) signals such as EEG, dependencies are organized along the electrode and time axes, and this uniform prior exposes each token to many irrelevant interactions. We introduce Adaptive Anisotropic Attention (AAA), which splits attention into two paths: a temporal path, where each token attends to the tokens of its own electrode across time, and a spatial path, where it attends to the tokens of the other electrodes at the same time step. A small gate predicts, for every token, a convex combination of the two path outputs: two non-negative weights that sum to one. On six EEG downstream tasks, the resulting model, AXON (AXis-factorized Operator Network), improves mean balanced accuracy over a dense baseline under both linear probing and full fine-tuning. We show that both paths (temporal and spatial) are necessary and that the weighted sum beats a hard choice of one path; most of the benefit comes from the gate learning a different temporal/spatial balance at each layer of the network. Controlled audio spectrogram experiments show that axis factorization transfers beyond EEG. These results suggest that aligning attention with the natural axes of structured signals provides a useful inductive bias.
2609.08788.paper_summary_zh: 密集自注意力在學習之前將所有標記對視為同等可能，這是一種與結構信號不匹配的交互各向同性先驗。對於結構性、低信噪比（SNR）信號，如腦電圖（EEG），依賴性沿著電極和時間軸組織，這種均勻的先驗使每個標記暴露於許多不相關的交互中。我們引入了自適應各向異性注意力（AAA），它將注意力分為兩條路徑：一條時間路徑，其中每個標記在時間上關注其自身電極的標記，另一條空間路徑，其中它在同一時間步驟關注其他電極的標記。一個小門控為每個標記預測兩條路徑輸出的凸組合：兩個非負權重之和為一。在六個EEG下游任務中，所得到的模型AXON（AXis-factorized Operator Network）在線性探測和完全微調下，改善了相對於密集基準的平均平衡準確率。我們顯示出這兩條路徑（時間和空間）都是必要的，並且加權和優於僅選擇一條路徑；大部分好處來自於門控在網絡每一層學習不同的時間/空間平衡。受控音頻頻譜圖實驗顯示，軸因子化超越了EEG的應用。這些結果表明，將注意力與結構信號的自然軸對齊提供了一種有用的歸納偏見。
